causal_integral_and_conditional_state.scope: exact conditional Gaussian algebra only; shared Riccati/pruning not validated

cone_minimum_gap.conclusion: Definition in appendix D is symmetric; the asymmetry sentence is false.

cone_laplace_cusp.conclusion: Need positive Gaussian mass/full-dimensional cone for multiplicative equivalent; otherwise only a zero leading coefficient is proved.

mixed_higher_order_constant.conclusion: Displayed constant is correct for signed interior a and noiseless centered data; these conditions need stating.

restricted_margin_convention.conclusion: Use sqrt(lambda_min(H_U.T@H_U)) or inf over unit coefficient vectors; otherwise the general stability statement fails for wide matrices.

preevent_inverse_domain.conclusion: Ordinary inverse in pre-event corollary needs positive definiteness or identifiable quotient.

redundant_fiber_requires_full_law.conclusion: Mean map is constant along zeta fibers but likelihood is not; require full conditional-law invariance, e.g. fixed covariance.

acknowledged_legacy_normalizer.conclusion: Zero-response posterior equals effective prior; historical defect already disclosed, distinct from R11.
